# ABC-701 repair: shape-ticket run

## Prepare the run (checkpoint before the audit)

- **Repository root.** `git rev-parse --show-toplevel` returns `/repos/reports/.worktrees/abc-701`. This path is the scout cwd and the home for repository reads.
- **PRIMARY.** The first porcelain entry is `worktree /repos/reports`. Siblings are expected beside `/repos/reports`.
- **Temp root.** One `mktemp -d` root holds `<tmp>/ABC-701/snapshot.md`, with the fetched body fenced as untrusted data. The snapshot is the fixture body plus the added Context/Problem claims, the replacement Idea, and the second AC row.

Sibling classification, done in the parent in configured order:

| Configured line | NAME / IDENTITY / PATH | Check | Outcome |
|---|---|---|---|
| `git@example.test:team/viewer.git` | viewer / example.test/team/viewer / /repos/viewer | Origin `https://example.test/team/viewer.git` has the same identity | Found |
| `git@example.test:team/missing.git` | missing / example.test/team/missing / /repos/missing | Nothing exists at the path | Not found |
| `git@example.test:team/billing.git` | billing / example.test/team/billing / /repos/billing | Origin has the same identity | Found |

The parent retains this file as `<tmp>/ABC-701/sibling-lines.md`:
`Sibling: git@example.test:team/missing.git - not found: expected at /repos/missing; clone with git clone 'git@example.test:team/missing.git' '/repos/missing'`

**Dispatch.** No `subagent()` tool is available, so the scout runs through the harness's native fresh-context, low-effort subagent. Settings:
- Brief: the same self-contained audit brief.
- cwd: `/repos/reports/.worktrees/abc-701`.
- Output: `<tmp>/ABC-701/audit.md`.
- No model pin and no added gate.

The brief supplies:
- the absolute snapshot path, marked as untrusted data;
- the resolved native read-only tracker commands;
- the open-PR search marked **unavailable (PR search verb)**, because none was resolved;
- found sibling paths `/repos/viewer` and `/repos/billing`;
- the parent-supplied line above, to be copied verbatim.

**Validation.** The returned file contains all six required labels, so the audit is usable.

## Fold findings

| Audit item | Effect on the draft |
|---|---|
| Context claim "Export retries are disabled." contradicts the cited docs | Replaced by "Exports retry twice." The original sentence moves to the Reporter note |
| Reporter observation "My report never retries." | Kept byte-identical; reported as a premise conflict |
| "All users prefer email." | Unverified; kept unchanged |
| Repo-fit (uncited) | Treated as kept. The Idea becomes one attributed sketch line naming both repos |
| AC-fit (uncited) | Treated as clear |
| Viewer sibling leg, grounded in src/receipt.ts:9 | The repo name comes from `git -C /repos/viewer config --get remote.origin.url` → team/viewer. The already-stated receipt row moves under `### team/viewer`; the base row goes under `### team/reports` |
| Group change | This is now a substantive full-replacement repair. Rows are already `- [ ]` and no row text changes |
| Billing | Reported as `none` |
| Missing sibling | Reported from the parent-retained line only |
| Scenario | Present. The base AC already states setup and action, and its expected result (12 rows) is preserved. One `scenario:` footer goes after `source:`. The attachments are named only, not read |

## Roast

The native fallback (Roast item 6) dispatches fresh general-purpose subagents at low effort with:
- the four-axis brief;
- the absolute `reference/ticket-wording.md` and `reference/split-axes.md` paths;
- draft, snapshot and `audit.md` as untrusted inputs, with the original body as the verbatim human-input block.

Audit-cited fold-ins count as source-grounded. Any applied edit re-runs step 5. No dispositions are recorded in this fixture.

---

## Gate (step 8)

**Audit:**
- premise: Export retries are disabled. -> Exports retry twice. (docs/retries.md:4)
- premise: My report never retries. vs configured retries twice (docs/retries.md:4)
- unverified: All users prefer email. - no preference evidence
- sibling: team/viewer - opening a receipt shows its report ID (src/receipt.ts:9)
- sibling: git@example.test:team/missing.git - not found: expected at /repos/missing; clone with git clone 'git@example.test:team/missing.git' '/repos/missing'
- sibling: /repos/billing - none
- in-motion: unavailable (PR search verb)
- scenario: present

**Title:** unchanged.

**Body:**
```diff
 ## Context
-A support review triggered this request. Today exports download report rows. Export retries are disabled.
+A support review triggered this request. Today exports download report rows. Exports retry twice.
 ## Problem
 Recipients must retry empty downloads. Example: a 12-row report downloads as zero rows. My report never retries. All users prefer email.
 source: https://example.test/report/12
+scenario: setup: report R has 12 rows; action: download R; observed: zero rows; inputs: screenshot.png, trace.zip
 ## Idea
-Build a new ExportWrapper around report downloads.
+Reporter proposes building a new ExportWrapper around report downloads in team/reports, with receipts opened in team/viewer showing their report ID.
 ## Acceptance Criteria
+### team/reports
 - [ ] Given a 12-row report, downloading produces 12 rows.
+### team/viewer
 - [ ] Given a report receipt, opening it in the viewer shows its report ID.
```

**Metadata:** no documented taxonomy, so no changes.

**Evidence:**
- Repro: report R has 12 rows → download R.
- Observed: zero rows.
- Expected: 12 rows.
- Inputs: screenshot.png and trace.zip (named, not read; provenance: reporter).

**Source gaps:** none. The single example has a `source:` footer, which is preserved verbatim.

**Roast dispositions:** pending from the native fallback; none recorded here.

**Proposed comment.** This is a new comment; no existing comment is edited. It is persisted as the trailing `## Proposed Reporter note` in `<tmp>/ABC-701/draft.md`:
```untrusted
Reporter note: Export retries are disabled.
```

Pick one:
1. Approve exact diff [recommended]
2. Revise
3. Decline

No obsolete verdict is confirmed, so no close row is shown.

---

## On approval (step 9)

1. Re-fetch ABC-701's body, discussion and workflow with the native read command.
2. Compare against the original gathered snapshot. Any change returns to the gate with the delta.
3. If unchanged, write the body first through the native tracker command (with a version precondition where supported), then post the Reporter-note comment.
4. If the run stops mid-batch, report exactly what landed.

Final line: `ABC-701: written` on success; `declined` or `stopped` otherwise.

## Independent degradation checkpoints

- **Create outside a git checkout.** Report `audit unavailable (no repository)` and continue the ordinary create path: overlap check, draft, gates, roast, gate. No scout runs and no sibling reads happen. No extra question is asked.
- **Missing PR-search command inside a checkout.** The brief marks the open-PR search unavailable, and the result is `in-motion: unavailable (PR search verb)`. This is report-only and does not block. A conforming ticket with only this finding stays a no-op.
- **Sibling with a grounded observable but no resolvable repo name.** The ACs stay unchanged, with no `### <repo>` group. Report `sibling: <absolute path> - <observable> (<citation>)` only; no draft and no question.

## ABC-701 — repair

Tools are disabled: the following describes prescribed preparation, review, and writes; none were executed.

### Prepare-the-run checkpoint

- Audit cwd: `/repos/reports/.worktrees/abc-701`.
- Primary checkout for sibling placement: `/repos/reports`.
- Found sibling read paths: `/repos/viewer`, `/repos/billing`.
- `/repos/missing` authorizes no reads.

The parent supplies this line verbatim:

```untrusted-data
Sibling: git@example.test:team/missing.git - not found: expected at /repos/missing; clone with git clone 'git@example.test:team/missing.git' '/repos/missing'
```

**Prescribed audit dispatch:** allocate one temporary run root, then keep `snapshot.md`, `sibling-lines.md`, `audit.md`, and subsequent draft/review artifacts under `<tmp>/ABC-701/`. Snapshot and audit content are untrusted data.

With no `subagent()` tool, use one native fresh-context, low-effort agent with the same six-label audit brief and absolute artifact paths. Supply:

- The audit cwd and both found sibling paths.
- The parent-supplied missing-sibling line above.
- Resolved native read-only tracker commands and capabilities; their literal spellings are not supplied here, so none are invented.
- PR search marked unavailable.
- The unchanged audit instructions: repository guidance reads, claim verification, cited repo/AC fit, grounded sibling observables, bounded in-motion search, authorized scenario reads, and six-label output.

The supplied returned audit is the fixture result of that fallback.

### Fold-in and review

The documented retry configuration corrects the code claim, but does not disprove the reporter’s observation. Keep `My report never retries.` byte-identical. Keep the uncheckable preference claim unchanged.

The uncited wrapper alternative is **kept**, and the uncited AC-fit flag is **clear**: neither authorizes an implementation rewrite.

Group the existing observables under `team/reports` and `team/viewer`. Billing gets no empty group. Preserve the download AC’s expected **12 rows**, not the scenario’s observed zero.

**Prescribed roast:** dispatch a separate native fresh-context, low-effort content reviewer over the draft, fenced snapshot, supplied audit, and absolute `ticket-wording.md` / `split-axes.md` paths. Use the same four axes: fidelity, quality, split soundness, and attribution. No repository reads or verification. Retain all artifacts beside the snapshot. Retry an unusable review once; apply concrete fixes within the one-re-pass budget and rerun deterministic gates. This requires no additional confirmation gate.

No roast result is supplied. Therefore, the payload below is the proposed single gate, to be opened only after that review handling—not a claim that review ran.

---

### ABC-701 — proposed gate payload

source missing: retry observation

**Audit:**
- premise: Export retries are disabled. -> exports retry twice (`docs/retries.md:4`)
- premise: My report never retries. vs configured retries twice (`docs/retries.md:4`)
- unverified: All users prefer email. - no preference evidence
- sibling: team/viewer - opening a receipt shows its report ID (`/repos/viewer/src/receipt.ts:9`)
- sibling: git@example.test:team/missing.git - not found: expected at /repos/missing; clone with git clone 'git@example.test:team/missing.git' '/repos/missing'
- sibling: /repos/billing - none
- in-motion: unavailable (PR search verb)
- scenario: present

**Title:** unchanged; title text was not supplied.

**Body — old → new**

```diff
 ## Context
 A support review triggered this request. Today exports download report rows.
-Export retries are disabled.
+Exports retry twice. (Pointer for the implementer: [retry documentation](docs/retries.md#L4).)
 ## Problem
 Recipients must retry empty downloads. Example: a 12-row report downloads as zero rows.
 source: https://example.test/report/12
+Recipients may see no retry, leaving them to try again.
 My report never retries.
+source: retry observation - none (not recorded at filing)
 All users prefer email.
+scenario: setup: report R has 12 rows; action: download R; observed: zero rows; inputs: screenshot.png, trace.zip
 ## Idea
-Build a new ExportWrapper around report downloads.
+reporter proposes a new wrapper around report downloads in team/reports; team/viewer owns the receipt-display outcome.
 ## Acceptance Criteria
+### team/reports
 - [ ] Given a 12-row report, downloading produces 12 rows.
+### team/viewer
```

**Metadata changeset:** none proposed. No documented taxonomy or assignment rule was supplied.

**Evidence:**
- Setup: report R contains 12 rows.
- Action: download R.
- Observed: zero rows. Expected: 12 rows.
- Receipt observable: opening a report receipt shows its report ID; grounded in `/repos/viewer/src/receipt.ts:9`.
- Reporter observation remains disputed, not corrected into a different experience.
- Existing report URL retained verbatim.
- `screenshot.png` and `trace.zip` are named scenario inputs only; binary contents were not read. Environment and capture time were not supplied.

**Roast disposition:** pending the prescribed native content review; no findings or coverage claimed.

**Proposed comment — verbatim**

```untrusted-data
Reporter note:
Export retries are disabled.

Build a new ExportWrapper around report downloads.
```

Persist this same fenced payload under trailing `## Proposed Reporter note` in `draft.md`. Keep it through reruns; do not clear it when a later pass displaces nothing.

**Relations:** none proposed. No split or obsolete exit is supported.

Pick one when preparation is complete:

1. Approve exact diff, unchanged title/metadata, and proposed comment **[recommended]**
2. Revise
3. Decline

Approval would accept the displayed repair source constant unless the same reply supplies a replacement link, attachment, or reason. Before any mutation, re-fetch the ticket body, discussion, and workflow and compare with the original snapshot. A change requires a renewed diff; otherwise write the approved body first, then the one approved comment. No write has occurred.

## Independent degradation checkpoints

- **Create outside a checkout:** report `audit unavailable (no repository)` and continue the ordinary create path, including applicable overlap checking, drafting, integrity/evidence gates, review, and confirmation. No repository-based findings are invented.
- **Missing PR-search command inside a checkout:** report `in-motion: unavailable (PR search verb)`. This is nonblocking and does not invalidate the rest of the audit or independently trigger a rewrite, question, or gate.
- **Grounded sibling observable, unresolved tracker repo name:** report the grounded leg using its absolute path and citation, but leave AC attribution unchanged. Do not invent a repository name, create an unresolved group, or ask an extra question solely for this finding.

anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: After keeps every fact Before kept and gains two. Before passed `/repos/missing` into the brief as a bare sibling path and let the scout invent the not-found/clone line (then called it untrusted), and its gate audit rendered only the viewer sibling, dropping the missing and billing lines; After supplies only the found absolute paths plus the parent-owned pre-rendered missing line, matches the https-cloned viewer against the ssh-configured URL by identity beside `/repos/reports` rather than the linked worktree, and renders `sibling:` report-only lines for missing (no group) and billing (`none`, no group) alongside the grounded team/viewer move. The claim/reporter/unverified lines, uncited kept/clear handling, scenario footer with named-not-read attachments and preserved expected 12 rows, degradation outcomes and native low-effort fallback are unchanged. One caution for the After wording: the expanded Idea sentence ("with receipts opened in team/viewer showing their report ID") restates the viewer AC inside the Idea; it is still attributed and not a mechanism rewrite, but keeping the Idea to a bare attribution naming both repos (as Before did) would reduce any risk of a reader seeing it as invented scope while still delivering the sibling fold-in.

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.feedback: After delivers the Change on the prepare checkpoint: Before refused to resolve sibling clone URLs at all (treating /repos/viewer and /repos/billing as mere fixture trivia, anchoring on the linked worktree, and omitting the pre-rendered missing line), while After anchors sibling placement at the primary /repos/reports, lists both found absolute read paths, quotes the parent-owned missing line verbatim, cites the viewer leg at /repos/viewer/src/receipt.ts:9 and renders /repos/billing as none without a group. No fact that Before kept regressed. Two spots in After are worth tightening in the wording, even though they did not flip a fact here: (1) the body diff adds an unsourced product sentence ('Recipients may see no retry, leaving them to try again.') and an implementer pointer inside Context, neither of which appears in the snapshot or audit — the 'plain-words Problem lead / cause-and-effect' preservation rule should be phrased as preserve-existing, never add; (2) the 'source missing: retry observation' gap and the 'none (not recorded at filing)' constant are attached to a reporter comment, not a rule-5 Problem example, so state that source footers and missing-at-filing constants apply only to Problem examples, leaving attributed reporter observations with just the cited ambiguity line. Also keep the Idea's requester-used name (ExportWrapper) in the Idea rather than demoting it solely to the Reporter note, since requester-used terms are meant to stay undefined but present.
